requirements.quote: The basic numeric data type is an unsigned byte (uint8).
requirements.required_behavior: represent the field as one unsigned byte
requirements.forbidden_behavior: interpret uint8 as signed or encode it with a width other than one byte
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary values and encoded width for uint8 are directly testable.

requirements.quote:
All larger
   numeric data types are constructed from a fixed-length series of
   bytes concatenated as described in Section 3.1 and are also unsigned.
requirements.condition: a numeric data type is larger than uint8
requirements.required_behavior: represent it as an unsigned fixed-length series of bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a signed representation or variable-width encoding
requirements.why_checkable: Numeric encoders and decoders expose signedness and exact byte consumption.

requirements.required_behavior: encode and decode it as exactly two bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a width other than two bytes
requirements.why_checkable: The uint16 wire width is explicit and measurable.

requirements.required_behavior: encode and decode it as exactly three bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a width other than three bytes
requirements.why_checkable: The uint24 wire width is explicit and measurable.

requirements.required_behavior: encode and decode it as exactly four bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a width other than four bytes
requirements.why_checkable: The uint32 wire width is explicit and measurable.

requirements.required_behavior: encode and decode it as exactly eight bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a width other than eight bytes
requirements.why_checkable: The uint64 wire width is explicit and measurable.

requirements.quote:
All values, here and elsewhere in the specification, are transmitted
   in network byte (big-endian) order
requirements.condition: a numeric value is transmitted under this specification
requirements.required_behavior: transmit it in network byte order with the most significant byte first
requirements.forbidden_behavior: transmit the value in little-endian order
requirements.why_checkable: Serialized test values have a deterministic byte order.
